basic_details.job_title: RWF Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Rail Wheel Factory (RWF) has announced 3 contract vacancies for the Junior Engineer post under advertisement number RWF/RC-1/157. Eligible retired non-gazetted staff from the Electrical department can apply offline by sending their applications through ordinary post or e-mail to The Senior Personnel Officer, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bengaluru on or before 6 November 2026. Applicants must submit the application format with a pasted passport size photograph and self-attested photocopies of their Service Certificate, Pensioner Identity Card, and Pension Payment Order. how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for RWF Junior Engineer (Control Group) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.rwf.indianrailways.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Rail Wheel Factory (RWF) to fill vacant positions in its Electrical department on a contract basis for retired personnel.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RWF Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Junior Engineer (Control Group) post under advertisement number RWF/RC-1/157.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed offline application form to the designated authority at Rail Wheel Factory is 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for this Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: Retired non-gazetted staff of the Electrical department in Level-6 Control Group who held the same cadre or up to three levels higher are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be up to 65 years of age. Employees removed, dismissed, or compulsorily retired due to disciplinary actions are not eligible.

faq.question: Q6. How will the salary or remuneration be calculated?
faq.answer: The remuneration is a fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for RWF Junior Engineer 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the format, attach required documents, and send it by ordinary post or email.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications can be sent to The Senior Personnel Officer, Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka, Bengaluru-560064, via ordinary post, email, or dropped in the box.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested photocopies of their Service Certificate, Pensioner Identity Card, Pension Payment Order (PPO), and Matriculation Certificate.

faq.question: Q10. How is the selection process conducted for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selection is finalized through an assessment of suitability and competency conducted by a committee of officers keeping operational requirements in view.
